configuration.openspec.agentAutoSubmit.d: When launching workflow commands into the IDE Agent panel (VS Code Chat/Copilot or Cursor), control whether the command is sent automatically or only prefilled. Applies to both VS Code and Cursor. never: always prefill; readOnly (default): auto-send explore and verify only; always: auto-send every workflow action including apply and archive. If auto-send is unsupported in your editor version, the extension prefills instead.
configuration.openspec.agentAutoSubmit.e: Never auto-send — always prefill the Agent input and wait for Enter.
Auto-send read-only workflow commands (explore, verify) in VS Code and Cursor.
Auto-send every workflow command (apply, archive, etc.) in VS Code and Cursor.
